name: Build a Mining Machine⛏️
desc:
Welcome to "Build a Mining Machine⛏️"

How to play:
- 🛒 Buy mining parts at the Parts Shop
- 🧩 Place them however you like
- 👆 Press "PLAY" to start mining
- 💰 Sell ores → 🔧 Upgrade parts → 🚀 Mine Everything!

🌟 Like the game & join the group for exclusive in-game rewards!

💤 Your machine keeps mining ores even while you're offline!
